messages:
oscar_customer: Hey team — after the blue/green rollout at ~11:02 UTC this morning our assistant started ignoring the system instruction pinned at the top of the conversation. Previously it always followed the agent persona, now it answers tersely and forgets the persona. Example below.

amanda_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a short convo that repros the issue? Got any request_ids from the API logs?

oscar_customer: Yep, reproducer below (trimmed). Request-id: req_0a9b3c. We send the messages array with a 2k token history, system prompt at index 0. Behavior before: respects persona. After: drops system completely after ~800 tokens into the history.

oscar_customer: ```json
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b-v1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful agent following rules X.Y.Z."}, {"role":"user","content":"<long conversation... ~2000 tokens>"}], "max_tokens":256 }'
```

amanda_support: Thanks — can you also share the response body (or paste a couple of responses) showing missing instruction?

oscar_customer: Sure — first response used to start: "As your agent, I'll..." Now it starts: "I can help with that." No persona, and later in thread it contradicts earlier setup.

carson_cs: We noticed several accounts report similar regressions after the canary. Filing internal. Can you confirm whether you were routed to redwood-3b-v1-quant or redwood-3b-v1-fp16 variant?

oscar_customer: We pinned model: redwood-3b-v1 (default). Didn't specify variant.

devops_bot: deploy-bot: blue-green rollout completed for service inference-api at 2025-10-12T11:02:11Z — canary traffic 12% -> 100% over 25m. Commit: d3f4b2a.

lee_runtime: Thanks for the logs. Two hypotheses: 1) new kernel change affects KV cache eviction threshold so system prompt may be evicted earlier for long histories; 2) routing to a model variant with different prefix-preservation config.

sarah_eng: Can you paste the exact token counts? We need sequence length distribution to check boundary conditions. Also, do you see any "truncation" warnings in the response metadata?

oscar_customer: No truncation field in response. Conversation about 2k tokens in messages, max_model_context is 4096. But behavior change seems to occur around 800 tokens.

amanda_support: Copying reproducer into a minimal test. If we can reliably repro, we'll try force-routing you to the previous runtime image.

lee_runtime: Quick test: try adding preserve_system_prefix: true in your request as a temporary workaround (we have an opt-in header for trial back-compat). Example: `X-Redwood-Feature: preserve-system-prefix=1`. Will that be possible for you?

oscar_customer: I can try — sending a couple of calls now. Request-id: req_0a9b3d.

oscar_customer: With header added — assistant resumes persona for one call, but next call (same session) drops it again. Looks like a per-request override works but not persisted for session.

carson_cs: Noted. Amanda — I'm escalating to eng-runtime. Include request_ids req_0a9b3c and req_0a9b3d and the deploy commit.

amanda_support: Escalating to runtime team. Lee/sarah, can you check if commit d3f4b2a modified kernel eviction thresholds or memalloc on kv-cache? Also check rollout config (we saw some canary routing rules changed last week).

sarah_eng: I'm pulling runtime logs for the commit now. Also will repro locally with forced long-convo to watch KV cache trims.

lee_runtime: Also worth checking if the fallback policy changed — if requests are occasionally hitting a smaller quantized variant with more aggressive context trimming. Looking at routing table...

devops_bot: alert: routing-policy change detected in service inference-api at 2025-10-12T10:58:03Z (policy: prefer-latency->prefer-cost for non-premium).

amanda_support: That routing-policy change might explain customers on default plans suddenly hitting a cheaper variant. Oscar, are you on standard plan?

oscar_customer: Yes, standard. We weren't on dedicated capacity.

carson_cs: Ok that's a big clue — policy switch + new runtime could cause combined regressions (new kernel + cheaper variant with smaller preserved prefix budget). We'll try repro under the exact routing and variant.

lee_runtime: Immediate mitigation: temporarily pin your requests to the non-cost-optimized route by adding header `X-Redwood-Preference: prefer-stability` (we can whitelist your org to route to the previous image). Amanda/CS can we apply a temporary routing override for acme-inc?

amanda_support: I'll request a routing override for acme-inc and follow up in this thread when done. ETA 30m.

oscar_customer: Thank you — can you also share a timeline of which commits rolled and exact times? We need this for our incident report.

sarah_eng: We'll provide a deploy + routing timeline. Also follow-up: collecting logs shows KV-cache trim calls triggered at ~token 768 on the new runtime image for long sessions; older image preserved until ~token 2300. That matches the ~800 token symptom.

carson_cs: Next steps: 1) Amanda to apply routing override for acme-inc -> previous image. 2) Eng to prepare rollback patch or config change to preserve system prefix across variants. 3) Short-term customer workaround: use header preserve-system-prefix or prefer-stability.

amanda_support: Routing override applied for acme-inc -> previous-runtime-image (confirmed). Please retest and paste new request-id.

oscar_customer: Retest req_0a9b3e — persona restored, long history keeps persona so far. Looks good.

amanda_support: Great — leaving this open until eng proposes a permanent fix. Thanks for the quick repro and patience. :raised_hands:

sarah_eng: We'll schedule a rollback or config fix depending on perf impact. Will post a postmortem once we have root cause and mitigation.

carson_cs: Marking as escalated -> eng-runtime, tag: priority P1 for regressions affecting persona preservation.

oscar_customer: Appreciate the responsiveness. Please keep us posted.
